products.note: Meeting analytics AI; engagement scoring; wellness insights; behavioral data privacy

profile_text.body:
Read is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA. The company describes itself as the fastest growing AI meeting assistant, offering real-time transcription, smart summaries, and AI-powered search and discovery across meetings, messages, emails, CRM systems, and documents. Its site positions the product as platform-agnostic, connecting across a range of third-party tools to deliver unified insights regardless of where a user works.

The company's primary product, Read.ai, falls in the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and includes meeting analytics, engagement scoring, wellness insights, and features oriented around behavioral data privacy. The site frames Read as an AI copilot capable of transforming communications into summaries and instant answers across devices.

The held facts record no litigation. Read.ai has a presence in the MCP server registry, though the listed MCP entries span a broad range of unrelated third-party tools and do not appear to be Read's own servers.
